```{ojs}
// Per-locale notebook text: same key tree per language, missing keys fall back to English.
// Both locales are fetched ONCE here (no `language` dependency) so toggling the
// language never hits the network — nbText is a pure lookup.
nbTextAll = {
  const [en, fr] = await Promise.all([
    FileAttachment("/data/lossDamage/text/en.json").json(),
    FileAttachment("/data/lossDamage/text/fr.json").json(),
  ]);
  return { en, fr: Lang.withFallback(fr, en) };
}

nbText = nbTextAll[language.key] ?? nbTextAll.en

nbTitle = nbText.meta.title

// Narrative prose: one file per block (data/lossDamage/text/<id>.<locale>.md),
// `title:` front matter + markdown body. The block id is the filename — the CMS
// (admin/config.yml) edits these; scripts/build/cmsContent.lua bakes English in at render.
// FileAttachment paths must be literal, hence the explicit map.
proseFiles = new Object({
  "overview": { en: FileAttachment("/data/lossDamage/text/overview.en.md"), fr: FileAttachment("/data/lossDamage/text/overview.fr.md") },
  "farm-size": { en: FileAttachment("/data/lossDamage/text/farm-size.en.md"), fr: FileAttachment("/data/lossDamage/text/farm-size.fr.md") },
  "extreme-event-loss": { en: FileAttachment("/data/lossDamage/text/extreme-event-loss.en.md"), fr: FileAttachment("/data/lossDamage/text/extreme-event-loss.fr.md") },
  "model-ensembles": { en: FileAttachment("/data/lossDamage/text/model-ensembles.en.md"), fr: FileAttachment("/data/lossDamage/text/model-ensembles.fr.md") },
  "ensemble-insights": { en: FileAttachment("/data/lossDamage/text/ensemble-insights.en.md"), fr: FileAttachment("/data/lossDamage/text/ensemble-insights.fr.md") },
  "loss-by-farm-type": { en: FileAttachment("/data/lossDamage/text/loss-by-farm-type.en.md"), fr: FileAttachment("/data/lossDamage/text/loss-by-farm-type.fr.md") },
  "summary": { en: FileAttachment("/data/lossDamage/text/summary.en.md"), fr: FileAttachment("/data/lossDamage/text/summary.fr.md") },
  "methods": { en: FileAttachment("/data/lossDamage/text/methods.en.md"), fr: FileAttachment("/data/lossDamage/text/methods.fr.md") },
})

// All block files load in parallel at page start (they don't block first paint —
// English is baked in by cmsContent.lua); the toggle is a plain lookup.
sectionsAll = {
  const load = (loc) =>
    Promise.all(
      Object.entries(proseFiles).map(async ([id, files]) => [
        id,
        Lang.parseBlock(await (files[loc] ?? files.en).text()),
      ]),
    ).then(Object.fromEntries);
  const [en, fr] = await Promise.all([load("en"), load("fr")]);
  return { en, fr };
}

sections = sectionsAll[language.key] ?? sectionsAll.en

// languages / langKey / language / _lang come from /components/_lang.qmd,
// included above with the notebook text cells.
```

```{ojs}
// Fill the `:::token:::` placeholders in a templated sentence from text/<locale>.json.
tmpl = (template, values) =>
  Lang.reduceReplaceTemplateItems(
    template,
    Object.entries(values).map(([name, value]) => ({ name, value })),
  )

// Data values (farm size class, hazard, scenario, ...) are English strings baked
// into the parquet files, so they double as the lookup keys for their labels.
farmSizeLabel = (k) => nbText.General.farmSizeClasses[k] ?? k
eventLabel = (k) => nbText.General.events[k] ?? k
lossLabel = (k) => nbText.LossFunctions.selectors.loss.options[k] ?? k
eventTypeLabel = (k) => nbText.LossFunctions.selectors.eventType.options[k] ?? k
scenarioLabel = (k) => nbText.Ensembles.scenarios[k] ?? k
modelLabel = (k) => nbText.LossByFarmType.selectors.model.options[k] ?? k
thresholdLabel = (k) => nbText.LossByFarmType.legend.options[k] ?? k

//TODO: country names stay as the raw `nm_slc0` data values — translating them
// needs an nm_slc0 -> iso3 -> data/shared/atlas_countries.json lookup, and the
// aggregate ("Sub-Saharan Africa") has no iso3. Add when a French review asks.

numFormat = formatNumCompactShort({ locale: language.locale })

// Zero means the extreme event never occurred, not "0 farms".
farmCount = (d) => (d !== 0 ? numFormat(d) : nbText.General.noEvents)
```

## Data

```{ojs}
// hyparquet (pinned): 16KB pure-JS parquet reader, no DuckDB-wasm. It decodes
// GeoParquet WKB geometry to GeoJSON for us, so the boundaries only need
// rewinding for d3's winding order — no separate WKB helper needed.
// hyparquet-compressors adds ZSTD (GDAL's default).
hypq = import("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/hyparquet@1.26.2/+esm")

hypq_compress = import("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/hyparquet-compressors/+esm")

// Rewinding is load-bearing, not cosmetic: the source rings wind the other way,
// so d3 reads each polygon as the whole sphere minus the region (geoArea 4π).
turfRewind = (await import("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@turf/rewind/+esm")).default

// Shared contributor registry (id -> {name, org}); see the contributors cell.
contributors = FileAttachment("/data/shared/contributors.json").json()
```

```{ojs}
bound_arrayBuf = await FileAttachment(
  "/data/lossDamage/bounds.parquet",
).arrayBuffer();

loadBounds = async (country) => {
  const bounds = await hypq.parquetQuery({
    file: bound_arrayBuf,
    compressors: hypq_compress.compressors,
    columns: ["GID_0", "NAME_0", "NAME_1", "nm_slc0", "geometry"],
    filter: !country
      ? null
      : {
          nm_slc0: {
            $eq: country,
          },
        },
  });
  return {
    type: "FeatureCollection",
    features: bounds.map(({ geometry, ...properties }) => ({
      type: "Feature",
      geometry: turfRewind(geometry, { reverse: true }),
      properties,
    })),
  };
};

boundsCache = new Map()

// Sections 1 and 4 pick a country independently but start on the same one, so
// without this the ~100ms decode+rewind of the 1.4MB boundary file runs twice on
// load and again whenever the two selections coincide. Caching the promise (not
// the result) also collapses the two concurrent first calls into one read.
getBounds = (country) => {
  if (!boundsCache.has(country)) boundsCache.set(country, loadBounds(country));
  return boundsCache.get(country);
};

fig1_mapBounds = await getBounds(fig1_inputs.country);
fig4_mapBounds = await getBounds(fig4_inputs.country);
```

```{ojs}
renderS1_insight = () => {
  const _data = fig1b_filtered;
  const _present = _data.filter((d) => d.variable === "Current Farms");
  const _future = _data.filter((d) => d.variable === "Farms 2050");

  const sum = (arr) => arr.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);

  const sumpr = sum(_present.map((d) => d.value));
  const sumfr = sum(_future.map((d) => d.value));

  const t = nbText.FarmSize.insight;
  const pct = ((sumfr - sumpr) / sumpr) * 100;

  // 18 of the 357 country/size combinations have no farms in the baseline
  // (e.g. Djibouti, 10-20 ha), so the percent change is Infinity — say how many
  // farms are projected and leave the change out.
  const change = !sumpr
    ? ""
    : tmpl(t.change, {
        trend: pct > 0 ? t.trend.increase : t.trend.decrease,
        pct: pct.toLocaleString(language.locale, { maximumFractionDigits: 1 }),
      });

  return md`#### ${tmpl(nbText.General.quickInsights, { subject: fig1_inputs.country })}

${tmpl(t.baseline, {
  country: fig1_inputs.country,
  farms: numFormat(sumpr),
  size: farmSizeLabel(fig1_inputs.fSize),
})}

${tmpl(t.projection, { future: numFormat(sumfr) })} ${change}
`;
};
```

#### 4b code

```{ojs}
// 126k rows across the 2100 selector combinations, and hyparquet applies `filter`
// after decoding — so filtering in the query costs a full decode (~175ms) on every
// selector change. Decode once into a lookup instead; each combination is ~60 rows.
fig4b_byCombo = {
  const rows = await hypq.parquetQuery({
    file: await FileAttachment("/data/lossDamage/fig4b.parquet").arrayBuffer(),
    compressors: hypq_compress.compressors,
    columns: [
      "nm_slc0",
      "farm_sz2",
      "Event",
      "model",
      "year",
      "losstype",
      "threshold",
      "threshold2",
      "cum_sum",
    ],
  });

  const byCombo = new Map();
  for (const row of rows) {
    const key = [row.nm_slc0, row.farm_sz2, row.Event, row.model].join("|");
    const bucket = byCombo.get(key);
    bucket ? bucket.push(row) : byCombo.set(key, [row]);
  }
  return byCombo;
}

// Every combination the section 4 selectors can produce is present here (checked
// against fig4_map_fin_spei12_high.parquet: 2100 combinations on both sides), so a
// miss means the two files have drifted apart and should fail loudly.
fig4b_filtered = fig4b_byCombo.get(
  [
    fig4_inputs.country,
    fig4_inputs.fSize,
    fig4_inputs.event,
    fig4_inputs.time,
  ].join("|"),
)
```

```{ojs}
renderS4b_insight = () => {
  const _data = fig4b_filtered;
  const years = _data.map((d) => d.year);
  const minyear = Math.min(...years);
  const maxyear = Math.max(...years);

  const maxYearData = _data.filter((d) => d.year === maxyear);

  const maxLoss = maxYearData.find((d) => d.losstype === "Loss");

  const revenueAtMax = maxYearData.filter((d) => d.losstype === "Revenue");

  const minThreshold = revenueAtMax.reduce((a, b) =>
    a.threshold2 < b.threshold2 ? a : b,
  );

  const maxThreshold = revenueAtMax.reduce((a, b) =>
    a.threshold2 > b.threshold2 ? a : b,
  );

  const payout = maxLoss.cum_sum / (maxyear - minyear);
  const t = nbText.LossByFarmType.insight;

  const shared = {
    event: eventLabel(fig4_inputs.event),
    country: fig4_inputs.country,
    model: modelLabel(fig4_inputs.time),
  };

  return md`### ${tmpl(nbText.General.quickInsights, { subject: fig4_inputs.country })}

${tmpl(t.losses, {
  ...shared,
  minYear: minyear,
  maxYear: maxyear,
  farms: numFormat(maxLoss.cum_sum),
  size: farmSizeLabel(fig4_inputs.fSize),
  payout: numFormat(payout),
})}

${tmpl(t.revenue, {
  ...shared,
  minFarms: numFormat(minThreshold.cum_sum),
  minPct: minThreshold.threshold2,
  maxFarms: numFormat(maxThreshold.cum_sum),
  maxPct: maxThreshold.threshold2,
})}
`;
};
```

### Geo helpers

```{ojs}
// The tabular data and the boundaries share these four admin columns; joining on
// the composite key keeps like-named regions in different countries apart.
adminKey = (o) =>
  ["GID_0", "NAME_0", "NAME_1", "nm_slc0"].map((k) => o?.[k] ?? "").join("|")

// mergeDataToBoundaries parks the matched row at properties.data.
plotMap = (features, valueField, { height = 500, scheme = "YlGnBu" } = {}) => {
  const value = (f) => f.properties.data?.[valueField];

  return makeChoropleth({
    features,
    width,
    height,
    fill: value,
    color: {
      scheme,
      tickFormat: numFormat,
      label: nbText.General.numFarms,
    },
    channels: {
      value: {
        value,
        label: nbText.General.numFarms,
      },
      gid_0: {
        value: (f) => f.properties.GID_0,
        label: nbText.General.iso3,
      },
      country: {
        value: (f) =>
          f.properties.nm_slc0 === "Sub-Saharan Africa"
            ? f.properties.NAME_0
            : f.properties.nm_slc0,
        label: nbText.General.country,
      },
      region: {
        value: (f) =>
          f.properties.nm_slc0 === "Sub-Saharan Africa"
            ? null
            : f.properties.NAME_0,
        label: nbText.General.region,
      },
    },
    tooltip: {
      format: {
        value: farmCount,
        country: true,
        region: true,
        gid_0: true,
      },
    },
  });
}
```
